labels.title: The Value Proposition Canvas
labels.valueProposition: BrandWala Retail – Market-Aware Cross-Border Commerce Platform
labels.customerSegment: Cross-Border Resellers, Wholesale Importers & K-Beauty Retail Operations

pains.title: Manual Price Copying & Catalog Drift
pains.note: Resellers spent hours manually browsing UK wholesale websites and copying GBP prices into spreadsheets, causing stockouts and stale exchange rates.

pains.title: Disputed Multi-Tier Commission Calculations
pains.note: Calculating custom price markups, delivery charge adjustments, COD percentages, and packing fees by hand led to payout reconciliation errors.

pains.title: Firestore Quota Inflation & High Read Costs
pains.note: Unbounded Firestore queries on large order catalogs rapidly consumed free quotas and caused UI slowdowns during search.

gains.title: Automated Python Scraping & Ingestion Pipelines
gains.note: Engineered automated ETL scrapers for kobareseller.com (session/CSRF auth) and WooCommerce APIs, automatically upserting categorized catalog items.

gains.title: Deterministic 5-Layer UI Commission Engine
gains.note: Built a centralized mathematical calculation engine that computes live breakdowns at checkout and persists immutable snapshots on orders.

gains.title: Quota-Optimized Querying & Derived Projections
gains.note: Implemented debounced searches, cursor pagination, status-filtered batch reads, and derived Customer Order Book collections.
